pull_request.title: Inspect saved Utility findings with native source records
pull_request.body:
## Why this change is needed

The Utility review desk shows source-row pointers for a saved finding, while the separate native evidence command already returns the full cited CSV records. A reviewer following up in the desk should be able to inspect those records and keep their current notes and filters.

## Resulting behavior

- Optional paired `review-desk --data EXPORT --report SUMMARY` configuration enables **Inspect source records** for the selected current finding. The existing worksheet-only invocation remains usable.
- The authenticated loopback endpoint accepts exactly the admitted worksheet snapshot and current row ID. The browser supplies no filesystem path.
- A small adapter calls the unchanged native `evidence.write_evidence` in a private request directory. It compares all finding fields, evidence version, ordered source pointers and report metadata against the admitted row and manifest, and checks the selected worksheet bytes before and after.
- The page renders literal fields in source header order and offers an explicit download of the exact checked UTF-8 JSON bytes. It rejects output above 8 MiB without truncation.
- Selecting another finding discards an outstanding response and its old download. Source inspection preserves annotation drafts, filters, worksheet download/reconciliation and checker/payment behavior.

Inspection is a checked snapshot; it does not monitor subsequent filesystem changes or promise an atomic cross-file snapshot beyond the native writer's existing rechecks.

## Scope and composition

Author attribution: `estate-68094585a1c2 / production`, continuing as `chatgpt:68094585a1c2`.

The source change has 12 files: two small source-inspection modules, narrow desk/CLI/HTML/CSS hooks, focused native/browser controls and existing desk documentation. The native writer, checker, reconciliation, worksheet and report modules are unchanged. Utility coverage issue #52 retains its separate modules and command-specific CLI/README additions; duplicate-header PR #24, Freight, PT and shared CI are preserved.

The complete current main tree at `c1f6fa79518bac5ca9836e6f931766368804ba7a` was retained. All 110 explicitly allowed source/evidence entries match their native Git blob IDs in resulting tree `18387e31ed12c26ee1bd8779b4768445140c6273`; all other 1,214 pre-existing leaves remain exact. The intervening main change since the original author baseline affects only Freight comparison and its receiving evidence.

## Author verification

| Evidence | Actual result |
| --- | --- |
| Unchanged Utility baseline, Python 3.14.4 / pytest 9.0.2 | 149 tests and 59 subtests passed |
| Original native fixture/evidence/desk | Existing workflow succeeded; proposed source route returned 404 and optional flags returned argparse exit 2 |
| Candidate v1 focused suite | 12 methods and 22 subtests passed |
| Candidate v2 Utility suite | 161 tests and 81 subtests passed in 60.88 seconds |
| Candidate v2 Python `-O` | All 12 new methods passed |
| Actual Node 22 / Chromium 153 browser | 14 controls passed, with captured downloads and screenshots |

Browser controls include two accounts sharing a bill key, literal Unicode/script/formula/multiline cells, byte-identical native JSON downloads, delayed previous-selection responses, real native-valid source drift and restored-source retry, preserved drafts and filters, and the existing 320-pixel layout. No external page request or JavaScript exception was observed; all watched source files remained exact.

The [sealed author packet](https://github.com/Jacob-Met/workflow-checks/tree/08af0d16a33d47446f768169cacdbef0dba595af/docs/receiving/utility-source-records-68094585a1c2) preserves original and v1/v2 overlays, pins, original logs, browser fixtures/downloads/screenshots, public contract and publication manifest. Recovery re-read all 39 original and 43 candidate inputs without rerunning the same suites. Its manifest SHA-256 is `f3bd33607544a435f4318b3c705161dd978cc907e7c28a6085161173b126e41a`.

Earlier parent-reported Mac timeout and unknown-write attempts have no recovered native artifact or process identity; they are explicitly unaccepted and provide no Mac qualification. Only fictional fixtures were used.

## Receiving status

Independent root receiving is in progress against expectations frozen from the public contract and original source. Hosted exact-source gates start with this normal PR. Their results are pending; root retains the final merge.

Fixes #53.

issue.title: Inspect a saved Utility finding's source records in the review desk
issue.body:
## Reviewer outcome and exact source scope

Contributor: `estate-68094585a1c2 / production`, coordinated with root under Jacob's continuing native product mandate.

A person following up a saved Utility Watch finding can currently see its source row pointers in the browser desk, while the separate native `uwatch evidence` command already produces the complete referenced CSV records. Add **Inspect source records** to the current-finding desk, plus an explicit download of the same native JSON bytes. This inspection does not change review notes, findings or payment eligibility.

### Current source and actual baseline

Pinned main `76e6175d91320ac816cee019df969c0f0e1bbfc7`, complete tree `256483cd5c7cbb3731e5a6c322a117900ab24b65` (1,171 leaves). No AGENTS.md or CONTINUE instructions occur in that tree. Current project issues/PRs and all current #140 comments were checked; completed desk #31 is the receiving source.

On the already installed ThinkPad Python 3.14.4 / pytest 9.0.2, the unchanged Utility suite passed **149 tests and 59 subtests**. Thirty-nine executable source/test/docs/sample/workflow inputs were materialized with exact Git-blob checks; the entire original tree is retained as metadata.

An actual unchanged native fixture → review → `uwatch evidence` run returned valid source records and exact finding/evidence identity. The existing desk opened the same saved worksheet and produced a native-valid unchanged download. The proposed source-record HTTP route returned 404, and the optional source CLI arguments returned argparse exit 2. All 12 watched source/report/worksheet files remained exact. Original native receipts and logs are under `/tmp/hamon-utility-evidence-desk-68094585a1c2/baseline-evidence/`; fixtures are fictional.

### Bounded contract

- Optional paired `review-desk --data EXPORT --report SUMMARY` configures source inspection; the existing worksheet-only invocation remains usable.
- The existing authenticated loopback desk accepts exactly a snapshot ID and current row ID. It accepts no path from the browser.
- A small adapter invokes unchanged `evidence.write_evidence` in a private request directory, retaining its native checker/report validation, CSV record parsing and source custody rechecks.
- Compare every produced finding field, finding ID, evidence version, ordered source pointers and report metadata to the admitted current worksheet row/manifest. Check selected worksheet bytes before and after. Historical, mismatched, changed or malformed inputs refuse without changing saved inputs or in-page notes.
- Return the producer's exact UTF-8 JSON bytes, with an 8 MiB whole-output desk limit. Render header-order fields as literal text, including whitespace and multiline values. A download keeps those exact response bytes.
- Moving to another row invalidates an outstanding response and its download. Source inspection does not read or update annotation drafts, filters, review status or the existing download fingerprint. The displayed result is a checked snapshot, not filesystem monitoring or reconciliation.

### Write fence and preserved ownership

New `utility_watch/uwatch/review_evidence.py` and `review_evidence.js`; additive source-inspection hooks in `review_desk.py/js/html/css` and the existing `review-desk` CLI parser/dispatch; focused native/browser controls, the existing desk guide and one README pointer; unique receiving evidence.

Preserve `evidence.py`, `review.py`, `engine.py`, worksheet/review-report behavior, all auth restrictions and payment rules. New coverage owner #52 retains `bill_coverage.py`, `coverage_report.py` and its separate coverage CLI/README additions; shared CLI changes must compose by command-specific hunks. Preserve duplicate-header PR24, Freight #39/#49/#50/#51, PT #38/#43 and shared CI owners #6/#7. No other owner's checkout, dependency, installed service, provider, external data or default configuration is changed.

Native implementation and real browser receiving use a unique isolated source/profile with installed Python/Node/Chromium; no dependency installation. Root retains source PR/integration. This issue is an explicit source contribution notice, not transfer of an existing worker's ownership.
